parameters.content:
## P02 | Payment Tracking & Revenue Intelligence
**Internal payment form:** Login required; records a reported payment against an already ISSUED invoice. This does NOT charge a customer or verify money with any bank.
**Subworkflow input:** `{ "action":"payment", "invoice_id":"INV-...", "amount_usd":125, "payment_reference":"bank-ref-...", "payment_method":"Bank Transfer", "recorded_by":"Finance" }` or `{ "action":"report" }`.
**Manual Revenue Report:** one-click report using the n8n Data Tables. **RevenueDashboardForm:** logged-in, read-only HTML KPI dashboard in the browser.
**Tables:** P02_Invoices, P02_Payments, P02_RevenueSnapshots.
**Control:** duplicate references blocked, overpayments rejected, paid value is derived from recorded payment ledger, report flags mismatches. Production payment gateways need reconciliation, authorization and stronger transaction control.

parameters.formDescription: Internal finance entry. Only record externally verified receipts. Does not collect or move money.
Private read-only dashboard. Refresh by submitting this form. No invoices or payments are edited.
